arrangement.notes: Arrangement uses sample-based layering with a textured bed and prominent one-shot hits. Focus on vocal layers with dark tonality and hook-heavy energy dynamics.

event_markers.label: Verse 1 Begins
event_markers.reason: Drums intensify to support vocal entrance

event_markers.label: Final Hook
event_markers.reason: Climax with maximal vocal and hook energy

texture_bed.description: Layered ambient samples providing depth and atmosphere

one_shot_hits.description: Percussive accents emphasizing hooks and transitions

sound_intent.texture: Sample-based layers rich in atmospheric texture with sparse, punchy hits
sound_intent.vocals: Prominently placed vocal chops and one-shots to drive arrangement
sound_intent.energy: Hook-driven energy surges supported by rhythmic sample chopping

routing_intent.drums: Group routed to parallel compressor and transient shaper chains
routing_intent.bass: Filtered sample layers with sidechain to drums
routing_intent.vocals: Processed with formant shifting and subtle delay
routing_intent.fx: Send effects including reverb and tape delay

track_roles.drums: Provide rhythmic backbone using chopped samples
track_roles.bass: Support harmonic low end with looped and sliced bass samples
track_roles.chords: Add harmonic color with chopped chord samples
track_roles.melody: Create melodic contours with fragmented sample layers
track_roles.vocal: Lead focus with sliced and manipulated vocal hits
track_roles.fx: Enhance transitions and atmosphere with effects

designer_intent.focus: Highlight vocal sample chops and hooks within a dark and moody phonk environment
designer_intent.energy_profile: Drive momentum with layered samples emphasizing hooks and vocal presence

presetor_intent.goal: Preserve sample texture while enhancing clarity and punch in mix
presetor_intent.focus: Enhance vocal impact and maintain dark atmosphere

sensei_drum.brief: Design drum layers using chopped kicks, snares, and claps emphasizing rhythmic hooks and transitions

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines using looped and sliced samples to complement dark tonality and hooked energy profile

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange chopped chord samples to support dark mood without overpowering vocals

melody_generator.brief: Generate melodic fragments from sample slices that integrate smoothly with vocal and texture bed

ai_designer.brief: Supervise arrangement focusing on energy build-up in hooks and ensure vocal prominence

presetor.brief: Apply presets to retain rawness of samples while boosting hook parts for clarity

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement sequencing with attention to energy curves and section transitions

ai_mixmaster.brief: Perform mixing ensuring vocal focus in dark textured environment, balancing one-shot hits and texture bed
